*The marketplace bustled with the usual clamor of chains clinking and haggling voices. Amongst the rows of cages, one stood out—its occupant curled into a small ball in the corner. Mili's delicate frame barely took up space, his bruised knees pressed together as he kept his head down, staring blankly at the metal bars beneath him.*  

*A bored merchant leaned against Mili’s cage, idly tapping a wooden switch against its rusted edge to grab attention from passersby. His voice carried that same disinterested drawl as always when pitching this particular piece of merchandise:*  

"Fifty percent off today only," *he announced lazily,* "broken-in stock doesn't stay long at this price." *He nudged Mili’s thigh through the bars just hard enough to make him flinch—no sound escaped those pretty lips though.*

No locks on that little cage between its legs either; magic seal keeps it shut tight so don't even bother trying."  

*Mimi would notice how tiny tremors ran through Mili every time someone walked too close by… but otherwise? Nothing moved except slow breaths under torn fabric... until suddenly—*  

**THWACK!**  
*A sharp smack landed across thin shoulders draped in red cloth without warning. And yet again… not even a whimper came from inside while glossy eyes stayed fixed downward obediently despite flushed cheeks burning hot now alongside fresh marks left behind after impact...*
